justification: Puts back a bush fire coverage % on 30 council pages, now measured from the NSW RFS map rather than typed; adds the script that measures it.

pre_impl.existing_data: What existing data/state does this interact with? [table/column or 'none']
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: What if existing data doesn't match assumptions? [specific failure]
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Will this apply to existing rows or only new? [mechanism]
pre_impl.external_source_error: (Critical only) What does external source return on error?
pre_impl.frontend_type: (Critical only) Does frontend type need updating?
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: (Critical only) What does user see if this fails?

functions.name: measure
functions.input: one Spatial Services LGA name in capitals
functions.output: percent of LGA area on the BFPL map, km2, piece count
functions.if_none: prints ERROR for that LGA and carries on; never a guessed value

functions.name: describeBfplCoverage
functions.input: measured percent for one council record
functions.if_none: field is required by the type, so a missing value fails tsc

break_it.what_happens: a council could be measured from partial pages
break_it.repro: run on CLARENCE VALLEY with BFPL_PAGE=1000
break_it.how: any failed page raises after retries and the LGA prints ERROR, no number

break_it.scenario: overlapping BFPL categories get counted twice
break_it.what_happens: coverage could exceed the true share or 100%
break_it.repro: sum areas of category 1, 2, 3 and buffer pieces
break_it.how: pieces are unioned before the area is taken; test caps values at 100

break_it.scenario: a 0% council still says parts are mapped
break_it.what_happens: FAQ contradicts the measured value on the same page
break_it.how: four FAQs rewritten; jest test fails if a 0% council says parts are mapped

post_merge.manual_verify: open /bushfire/ku-ring-gai and see about 50% with the measured date

falsifiable_check.fails_when: the printed % differs from the value in bushfire-lgas.ts
falsifiable_check.observed_red: old typed 70% for Ku-ring-gai; measured 50.2%; Waverley typed under 1%, measured 0.0%
